note: Brighton Recreation Area's modern campground on Bishop Lake, southeast Michigan west of US-23 near Howell/Brighton; open sites with shade trees in upper and lower loops, playground. Walk to the Bishop Lake day-use area (swim beach), boat launch, fishing pier and trailheads; the paved Access-to-Recreation Trail links the campground to the day-use area. --Claude
